title: LookRole
description: One colour role of a panel (look-roles.json `roles`): the name a host sets, its family, what it draws, the floor its value must clear, and its one default.

name.description: The role's name, the console's token name.

family.description: The family: theme and accent follow the look, fixed never moves, state is a lamp.

ground.description: The role is a ground: it is what the others are measured on, and carries no floor.

floor.title: Floor
floor.description: The contrast a role's value must clear against each ground it is drawn on.

on.description: The grounds it is measured on, by role name.

apart.title: Apart
apart.description: The contrast two roles that must be told apart keep between them.

ratio.description: The least contrast ratio between the two.

from.description: The roles it must differ from, by name.

default.description: The one default value of the role, the dark look's.
